mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT line_name),0) AS lineTotal, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS count FROM dwd_vehicle_line_order_info WHERE actual_pay_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT COALESCE(run_org,'其他') AS runOrg, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(),2) AS ratio FROM dwd_vehicle_line_order_info WHERE actual_pay_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY COALESCE(run_org,'其他')
SELECT line_name AS lineName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM dwd_vehicle_line_order_info WHERE actual_pay_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY line_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5

WITH station_count AS ( SELECT start_station AS station, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dwd_vehicle_line_order_info WHERE actual_pay_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY start_station UNION ALL SELECT end_station AS station, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dwd_vehicle_line_order_info WHERE actual_pay_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY end_station ) SELECT station, SUM(cnt) AS count FROM station_count WHERE station IS NOT NULL AND station != '' GROUP BY station ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5;
